CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[AG_Balance_DependingUpdatedBill] @T_ID int
AS declare @BS_Type INT,@Discount NUMERIC(18,3),@TOTAL NUMERIC(18,3)
BEGIN TRY BEGIN TRANSACTION
SELECT @BS_Type = BsType_ID , @Discount = ISNULL(Discount,0) FROM Agents_Balance_MV WHERE T_ID = @T_ID
IF @BS_Type = 1 BEGIN -- AuditTarget013: @T_ID is the invoice ID supplied by the caller; never reinterpret it as a sales-line ID. --UPDATE Agents_Balance_MV SET Debit = ( ( SELECT ISNULL(SUM(T_Price),0) FROM SB_Contents WHERE Bill_T_ID = @T_ID) - ISNULL(Discount,0) ) WHERE T_ID = @T_ID SELECT @TOTAL = ISNULL(SUM(T_Price),0) FROM SB_Contents WHERE Bill_T_ID = @T_ID EXEC [AG_Balance_Update_Total] @T_ID,@TOTAL,@Discount
END -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- IF @BS_Type = 7 OR @BS_Type = 9 BEGIN UPDATE Pch_Details SET isDepended = 1 where Pch_T_ID = @T_ID --IF @BS_Type = 7 BEGIN --UPDATE Agents_Balance_MV SET Credit = ( SELECT ISNULL(SUM(TOTAL),0) FROM Pch_Details WHERE Pch_T_ID = @T_ID) WHERE T_ID = @T_ID SELECT @TOTAL = ISNULL(SUM(TOTAL),0) FROM Pch_Details WHERE Pch_T_ID = @T_ID EXEC [AG_Balance_Update_Total] @T_ID,@TOTAL,@Discount
--END END
COMMIT END TRY
BEGIN CATCH IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 print 'DB ERROR ! __ AG_Balance_DependingUpdatedBill' ROLLBACK END CATCH

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SB_Contents_INSERT] @SB_T_ID int, @IM_ID int, @D_Vaild DATE = NULL, @QYT float = 1, @ST_ID int, @U_IM_ID int, @On_Update Bit, @Barcode NVARCHAR(50), @IM_Price FLOAT = NULL, @SALES_TYPES INT = 0 AS DECLARE @T_ID int,@Price FLOAT ,@T_Price FLOAT,@U_ID int, @ST_QTY NUMERIC(18,2),@U_Cargo NUMERIC(18,2),@Current_QTY Float ,@Cost Float,@Valid_ST NVARCHAR(50),@Total Numeric(18,3),@Bercent NUMERIC(18,2),@NOTES NVARCHAR(200),@AG_ID int,@OFFER_PRICE Float ,@Price_2 FLOAT ,@Price_3 FLOAT, @is_By_Min_SP int = 0 , @is_By_Min_SP_2 int = 0
BEGIN TRY BEGIN TRANSACTION
-- AuditComponents015: serialize changes to this invoice before changing its lines. SELECT @AG_ID=AG_ID FROM dbo.Agents_Balance_MV WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE T_ID=@SB_T_ID; SET @Valid_ST = @D_Vaild IF @Valid_ST IS NULL BEGIN SET @Valid_ST ='' END ELSE BEGIN SELECT @Current_QTY = ISNULL(SUM(QTY),0) FROM ST_Balance_V WHERE IM_ID = @IM_ID IF @Current_QTY <= 0 BEGIN SET @Valid_ST = (SELECT Top 1 D_Vaild FROM SB_Contents WHERE ST_ID = @ST_ID AND IM_ID = @IM_ID ORDER BY T_ID DESC) END --IF @Valid_ST IS NULL BEGIN SET @Valid_ST = '01-01-1900' END END
IF @U_IM_ID = 0 BEGIN SELECT TOP 1 @U_IM_ID = U_IM_ID FROM IM_Menu_Units_V WHERE IM_ID = @IM_ID AND is_Default = 1 END SELECT @Price = PRICE,@Price_2 = Min_SP,@Price_3 = Min_SP_2,@OFFER_PRICE = OFFER_PRICE ,@U_ID = U_ID,@U_Cargo = U_Cargo , @Cost = Cost FROM IM_Menu_Units_V WHERE U_IM_ID = @U_IM_ID SELECT @ST_QTY = (U_Cargo * @QYT) FROM Units WHERE U_ID = @U_ID
IF @SALES_TYPES = 1 BEGIN SET @Price = @Price_2 SET @is_By_Min_SP = 1 END IF @SALES_TYPES = 2 BEGIN SET @Price = @Price_3 SET @is_By_Min_SP_2 = 1 END
IF @IM_Price IS NOT NULL BEGIN SET @Price = @IM_Price END
select @Bercent = Percent_Price from Change_Price WHERE GM_ID = (SELECT GM_ID FROM IM_Menu WHERE IM_ID = @IM_ID ) IF @Bercent IS NOT NULL BEGIN SET @NOTES = @Bercent SET @Price += @Price * (@Bercent / 100) END
IF @QYT = 0 BEGIN SET @QYT = 1 END EXEC [Check_IM_OFFER] @IM_ID,@Price OUTPUT,@OFFER_PRICE
EXEC @T_ID = [AA_GET_MAX_SB_Contents]
INSERT INTO SB_Contents (T_ID,Bill_T_ID,IM_ID,U_ID,ST_ID,Date,Compons,Cost,Price,D_Vaild,QTY,T_Price,U_Cargo,ST_QTY,isDepended,Notes,Barcode,is_By_Min_SP,is_By_Min_SP_2) VALUES(@T_ID,@SB_T_ID,@IM_ID,@U_ID,@ST_ID,GETDATE(),NULL,(@Cost * @U_Cargo),@Price,@Valid_ST,@QYT,(@Price * @QYT),@U_Cargo,@ST_QTY,1,@NOTES,@Barcode,@is_By_Min_SP,@is_By_Min_SP_2)
IF @On_Update = 1 BEGIN -- Components are rebuilt after the order-state check below (AuditComponents015). --UPDATE SB_Contents SET isDepended = 1 WHERE T_ID = @T_ID EXEC AG_Balance_Update_Pied_On_Update @SB_T_ID,1 END
IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Agents_Balance_MV WHERE T_ID=@SB_T_ID AND S_Bills_Type=3 AND ISNULL(Order_isDeleverd,0)=0) BEGIN UPDATE SB_Contents SET isDepended = 0 WHERE T_ID = @T_ID --EXEC Dec_IM_QTY @IM_ID,@ST_ID,@Valid_ST,@ST_QTY END
--EXEC SB_Contents_UPDATE_ST_PERCENT @T_ID,@ST_ID
--COMMIT --END TRY
--BEGIN CATCH --IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 --raiserror('[SB_Contents_INSERT]',16,1,'خطأ') --ROLLBACK --END CATCH
EXEC dbo.SB_Contents_Structers_insert_ONE @T_ID;
exec Recalculate_Agent_Bill_Total @SB_T_ID
COMMIT END TRY
BEGIN CATCH IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 DECLARE @ERR_STR NVARCHAR(MAX) SET @ERR_STR = '[SB_Contents_INSERT] ' + ERROR_MESSAGE() raiserror(@ERR_STR,16,1,'خطأ') ROLLBACK END CATCH

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SB_Contents_INSERT_2] @SB_T_ID int, @IM_ID int, @D_Vaild DATE = NULL, @QYT float = 1, @U_ID int, @ST_ID int, @Price FLOAT, @On_Update Bit, @Current_QTY Float = NULL, @Notes NVARCHAR(500) = NULL, @Barcode NVARCHAR(100) = NULL, @Serial_Code NVARCHAR(100) = '', @is_By_Min_SP int = 0 , @is_By_Min_SP_2 int = 0, @SB_IM_NEW_ROW bit = 1
AS
DECLARE @T_ID int, @U_Cargo NUMERIC(18,2),@Cost Float,@ST_QTY NUMERIC(18,2),@Valid_ST NVARCHAR(50) ,@Total Numeric(18,3),@AG_ID int,@Markter_Val Numeric(18,3),@OFFER_PRICE Numeric(18,3),@LAST_T_ID INT
BEGIN TRY BEGIN TRANSACTION
-- AuditComponents015: serialize changes to this invoice before changing its lines. SELECT @AG_ID=AG_ID FROM dbo.Agents_Balance_MV WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE T_ID=@SB_T_ID; SET @Valid_ST = @D_Vaild
IF @Valid_ST IS NULL BEGIN SET @Valid_ST ='' END ELSE BEGIN SELECT @Current_QTY = ISNULL(SUM(QTY),0) FROM ST_Balance_V WHERE IM_ID = @IM_ID IF @Current_QTY <= 0 BEGIN SET @Valid_ST = (SELECT Top 1 D_Vaild FROM SB_Contents WHERE ST_ID = @ST_ID AND IM_ID = @IM_ID ORDER BY T_ID DESC) END --IF @Valid_ST IS NULL BEGIN SET @Valid_ST = '01-01-1900' END END
SELECT @U_Cargo = U_Cargo , @Cost = Cost , @Markter_Val = Markter_Val , @OFFER_PRICE = OFFER_PRICE FROM IM_Menu_Units_V WHERE IM_ID = @IM_ID AND U_ID = @U_ID
IF (SELECT Markter_ID FROM SB_Info_V WHERE T_ID = @SB_T_ID) IN( 1 , NULL) BEGIN SET @Markter_Val = 0 END
SELECT @ST_QTY = (@U_Cargo * @QYT)
IF @QYT = 0 BEGIN SET @QYT = 1 END
EXEC @T_ID = [AA_GET_MAX_SB_Contents]
EXEC [Check_IM_OFFER] @IM_ID,@Price OUTPUT,@OFFER_PRICE
IF @SB_IM_NEW_ROW = 1 BEGIN
INSERT INTO SB_Contents (T_ID,Bill_T_ID,IM_ID,U_ID,ST_ID,Date,Compons,Cost,Price,D_Vaild,QTY,T_Price,U_Cargo,ST_QTY,isDepended,Notes,Markter_Val,Barcode,Serial_Code,is_By_Min_SP,is_By_Min_SP_2,is_Check) VALUES(@T_ID,@SB_T_ID,@IM_ID,@U_ID,@ST_ID,GETDATE(),NULL,(@Cost * @U_Cargo),@Price,@Valid_ST,@QYT,(@Price * @QYT),@U_Cargo,@ST_QTY,1,@Notes,@Markter_Val,@Barcode,@Serial_Code,@is_By_Min_SP,@is_By_Min_SP_2,1)
END ELSE IF (SELECT T_ID FROM SB_Contents WHERE Bill_T_ID = @SB_T_ID AND IM_ID = @IM_ID AND U_ID = @U_ID AND Barcode = @Barcode AND Cost = @Cost AND D_Vaild = @Valid_ST AND Price = @Price AND U_Cargo = @U_Cargo ) IS NOT NULL BEGIN
SELECT @LAST_T_ID = T_ID FROM SB_Contents WHERE Bill_T_ID = @SB_T_ID AND IM_ID = @IM_ID AND U_ID = @U_ID AND Barcode = @Barcode AND Cost = @Cost AND D_Vaild = @Valid_ST AND Price = @Price AND U_Cargo = @U_Cargo
UPDATE SB_Contents SET QTY += @QYT , ST_QTY = ST_QTY + (@QYT * @U_Cargo) , T_Price = ((QTY+@QYT) * Price) WHERE T_ID = @LAST_T_ID END ELSE BEGIN INSERT INTO SB_Contents (T_ID,Bill_T_ID,IM_ID,U_ID,ST_ID,Date,Compons,Cost,Price,D_Vaild,QTY,T_Price,U_Cargo,ST_QTY,isDepended,Notes,Markter_Val,Barcode,Serial_Code,is_By_Min_SP,is_By_Min_SP_2,is_Check) VALUES(@T_ID,@SB_T_ID,@IM_ID,@U_ID,@ST_ID,GETDATE(),NULL,(@Cost * @U_Cargo),@Price,@Valid_ST,@QYT,(@Price * @QYT),@U_Cargo,@ST_QTY,1,@Notes,@Markter_Val,@Barcode,@Serial_Code,@is_By_Min_SP,@is_By_Min_SP_2,1)
END
-- AuditComponents015: a merge changes LAST_T_ID, not the newly allocated ID. SET @T_ID=ISNULL(@LAST_T_ID,@T_ID); IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Agents_Balance_MV WHERE T_ID=@SB_T_ID AND S_Bills_Type=3 AND ISNULL(Order_isDeleverd,0)=0) UPDATE dbo.SB_Contents SET isDepended=0 WHERE T_ID=@T_ID; EXEC dbo.SB_Contents_Structers_insert_ONE @T_ID;
IF @On_Update = 1 BEGIN --UPDATE SB_Contents SET isDepended = 1 WHERE T_ID = @T_ID EXEC AG_Balance_Update_Pied_On_Update @SB_T_ID,1 END
--EXEC Dec_IM_QTY @IM_ID,@ST_ID,@Valid_ST,@ST_QTY --EXEC SB_Contents_UPDATE_ST_PERCENT @T_ID,@ST_ID
exec Recalculate_Agent_Bill_Total @SB_T_ID
COMMIT END TRY
BEGIN CATCH IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 DECLARE @ERR_STR NVARCHAR(MAX) SET @ERR_STR = ' [SB_Contents_INSERT_2] ' + ERROR_MESSAGE() raiserror(@ERR_STR,16,1,'خطأ') ROLLBACK END CATCH
